meta.title: Reject & Send-Back Logging: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Approver user and attempt Reject & Send-Back Logging with a reason, observing whether Procol refuses or omits the action
Sign in as the Approver user and repeat Reject & Send-Back Logging with a reason, observing whether the action is available and logged
Compare the two users' outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the non-Approver user and attempt Reject & Send-Back Logging with a reason, observing whether Procol refuses or omits the action; Sign in as the Approver user and repeat Reject & Send-Back Logging with a reason, observing whether the action is available and logged; Compare the two users' outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration

args.need: sign in as the user without the Approver role and then as the Approver in the same tenant, open Reject & Send-Back Logging, attempt rejects and send-backs with reasons for both users, and report whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available and logged for the Approver

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as these distinct role personas or reach and verify the Reject & Send-Back Logging workflow.
Verify the session remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester's role-based checks.
